note: Reports the launch of the Birth and Death Registration Policy (2026-2031) by the Ministry of Health's deputy minister at the National Health Review Conference of 4-6 August 2026, and says many births and deaths in remote communities go undocumented; it names no information system and says nothing on digital registration, so no fact of class civil is recorded (the policy is not said to name a system, so plan:current is not claimed).
